english.title: Act as member of flight crew of EASA / specified non-EASA aircraft registered outside United Kingdom when unlicenced
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acted as a member of the flight crew which must by or under the EASA Aircrew Regulation be carried in

(A)_[an EASA aircraft that is registered in a country other than in the United Kingdom]_
(B)_[a non-EASA aircraft that is referred to in paragraphs (a)(ii), (d) or (h) of Annex II of the Basic EASA Regulation that is flying for the purpose of commercial transport and that is registered in a country other than the United Kingdom]_

when neither article 61A(2), (3) nor (4) of the Air Navigation Order 2009 applied
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 61A and 241(7) of, and Part C of Schedule 13 to, the Air Navigation Order 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) 'Specified non-EASA aircraft' are those which are referred to in paragraphs (a) (ii), (d) or (h) of annex II of the Basic EASA Regulation that are flying for the purpose of commercial air transport and that are registered in a country other than the United Kingdom.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
